decisions.reason: The connected-wallet USDC approval issue does not change the distinct Transak fiat-to-USDC mint flow.
The source explicitly establishes that a completed ETH payment must result in an NFT mint; the existing same-message failure records the observed defect but not this expected outcome.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
When I attempt to mint using USDC, the approval transaction runs first and completes, but afterward I am not given any option to mint.

When I attempt to mint using ETH, there is no approval transaction; the transaction completes and deducts my ETH (0.0055 ETH = $16.75), but I do not receive an NFT.
